description: FaultForge load scenario for jade-7if. Many concurrent redemptions of one demo-kit code. Invariants: redemptions per code <= 1; audit rows == redemptions; every loser gets a distinct 'already redeemed' reply. Demo kit only, throwaway sandbox DB; no real codes. Adds a load check alongside jade-7if's own tests; does not replace them.
